capabilities: Fit wide Mermaid diagrams to the page width
Open a diagram at full size in an overlay on click
Zoom and pan large diagrams with wheel, pinch, or mouse
Close the overlay by clicking, tapping, or pressing Esc
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that keeps wide Mermaid diagrams readable.
problem: In Obsidian, Mermaid diagrams wider than the note become unreadable because they cannot be zoomed or viewed at full size.
summary: Diagram viewer that shrinks wide Mermaid diagrams to fit the page width and opens them at full size in a zoomable overlay on click.
